d: The theater represents a valley that has in perspective a chain of mountains, for one of which you go down to the floor on the side that indicates the common road. On the one hand a rock with some cavities that suppose the entrance to the mines. Next to the rock, outside the house of Tarabotto with practicable door. Direpetto, a large tree with a bench attached to the same. Tabarotto that comes out of one of the cavities with Miners, then Isabella.
Soldiers from the mountain, then Bertrando.
Isabella, then Tabarotto, which comes out hasty from the cavities.
Bertrand returning with the Soldiers, and Tabarotto.
Said. Isabella with a rather large folded card in her hand. She progresses slowly and always at the head of the bow.
Ormondo, Tabarotto in the background, then Batone.
Batone and Tabarotto on the side and then he shows up in time.
Tabarotto, then Isabella, who comes out circumspect and looks around.
